scope: The exec-workload dashboard surface = Workload Overview (DashboardPage.tsx, workload/summary+trend) + Director KPI strip (DirectorKpiStrip.tsx, exec/sla-summary + portfolio/summary). Both KPI strips audited because the prompt names both endpoint families.

kpiAudit.drilldownResult: 10 (status is a parsed filter key; enum value 'ACTIVE' matches item.status uppercase via strict !==)

kpiAudit.detail: 'rag' is NOT a key in ProjectsPage FILTER_DEFAULTS. useFilterParams (line 21) only reads Object.keys(defaults), so 'rag' is silently dropped. ProjectDirectoryItem also carries no rag/ragStatus field (verified live: itemHasRagField=false). KPI says 7 at-risk but the drilldown lands on all 40 projects with NO at-risk filter applied. Same bug class as the prior-round ProjectsPage ignored-param finding.

budgetStatus IS a parsed filter key AND the field exists on items, but the link value 'over' does not exist in the enum. ProjectBudgetStatus = 'GREEN'|'YELLOW'|'RED'|'UNSET' (project-registry.ts:11); live data shows only RED/YELLOW. ProjectsPage compares item.budgetStatus !== filters.budgetStatus (line 201), so 'over' matches NOTHING -> over-budget KPI drilldown yields an empty list. Directly analogous to the prior 'ACTIVE'!=='active' case-mismatch class.

kpiAudit.status: CONSISTENT (no filter claimed; broad but acceptable)

kpiAudit.drilldownResult: 33 projects have openPositionsCount>0 (10 of them ACTIVE); sum of openPositionsCount across all = 36
kpiAudit.detail: hasOpenGaps IS parsed and openPositionsCount IS on items, so the filter works (33 projects shown). But KPI counts 36 OPEN POSITIONS (sum of gaps) while the drilldown counts PROJECTS-with-gaps (33). Number shown (36) != rows in list (33) — a units mismatch, not a hard lie, since one click does reach the gap-bearing projects.

kpiAudit.status: CONSISTENT (number matches source + trend; drilldown unfiltered)

kpiAudit.drilldownResult: unfiltered people directory (137 in peopleWithNoActiveAssignments list)

kpiAudit.detail: KPI shows 10 active projects but the link is bare '/projects' with NO status filter, landing on the full 40-row registry. Unlike the Director strip, this link does not even attempt status=ACTIVE. KPI number (10) != drilldown list (40). Milder than a wrong-value param but still a Law-9 number/list divergence.

kpiAudit.drilldownResult: exceptions queue (0 unstaffed projects in source)

findings: LAW-9 LIE (ignored-param) — Director 'At-risk projects' KPI = 7 (byRag amber 5 + red 2) links to /projects?rag=AMBER,RED, but 'rag' is NOT in ProjectsPage FILTER_DEFAULTS; useFilterParams drops unknown params, so the drilldown shows ALL 40 projects with no at-risk filter. ProjectDirectoryItem also has no rag field (live itemHasRagField=false). Same ignored-param class as the prior ProjectsPage finding.

LAW-9 LIE (value-mismatch) — Director 'Budget variance' KPI links to /projects?budgetStatus=over, but the enum is GREEN|YELLOW|RED|UNSET (no 'over'); strict item.budgetStatus !== 'over' (ProjectsPage:201) matches 0 rows, so the over-budget drilldown lands on an EMPTY list. Same case/value-mismatch class as 'ACTIVE'!=='active'.

UNITS-MISMATCH — Director 'Open positions' KPI = 36 (sum of openPositionsCount / totalOpenGaps) but /projects?hasOpenGaps=true returns 33 projects-with-gaps; KPI counts positions, list counts projects (36 != 33).
MISSING-FILTER — Workload Overview 'Active Projects' KPI = 10 links to bare /projects (no status=ACTIVE), so the list shows all 40 registry rows (10 != 40).
CONSISTENT — Director 'Active projects' (10) drilldown /projects?status=ACTIVE correctly filters to 10 (status key parsed, 'ACTIVE' matches uppercase enum).
CONSISTENT — Workload Active Positions (95) matches workload/summary AND trend last point; Available People (137) and Open Issues (0) match their summary fields.
ALL KPI ENDPOINTS HEALTHY — exec/sla-summary, workload/summary, workload/trend, workload/planned-vs-actual, portfolio/summary all returned HTTP 200 with director token. No errored KPI endpoint.
evidence: Live as director noah.bennett. workload/summary HTTP200 {totalActiveProjects:10, totalActiveAssignments:95, unassignedActivePeopleCount:137, projectsWithNoStaffCount:0}. workload/trend last point activeAssignments=95 (matches summary). exec/sla-summary HTTP200 (sampleSize 9). portfolio/summary HTTP200 {totalProjects:10, byRag green3/amber5/red2 => at-risk 7, totalOpenGaps:36}. GET /api/projects HTTP200: 40 total {ACTIVE:10,CLOSED:20,COMPLETED:10}; items carry budgetStatus(enum RED/YELLOW)+openPositionsCount but NO rag field. Replayed ProjectsPage filter logic against live rows: status=ACTIVE->10 (OK); rag=AMBER,RED->'rag' not in FILTER_DEFAULTS (useFilterParams.ts:21) so dropped -> all 40 shown vs KPI 7 (LIE); budgetStatus=over->0 rows (enum has no 'over', ProjectsPage.tsx:201 strict !==) vs over-budget KPI (LIE); hasOpenGaps=true->33 projects vs KPI 36 positions (units mismatch). Workload Active Projects KPI=10 links bare /projects -> 40 rows.
